[[File:MeruMine.jpg|thumb|200px|The entrance to the Mount Meru Mine.]]
The '''Mount Meru Mine''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mine]] located in the depths of [[Mount Meru (Drogheda)|Mount Meru]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Drogheda/Legends|Drogheda]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], a [[Drogheda Revolutionaries|militant revolutionary group]] captured the mine in order to force the reigning [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Sarna (Queen)|Sarna]] to agree to their demands to set up a democratic government. As the mine was a large source of income for the ruling class, Sarna was forced to look for outside help in removing the revolutionaries from the mine. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] hero [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] eventually aided Sarna in removing the revolutionaries by destroying several [[Water/Legends|water]] tanks deep within the tunnels. The mine was flooded by water, washing Calrissian and the rebels out of the mine&mdash;regime forces then shot the fleeing rebels who survived the flood.<ref name="marvel83">[[Star Wars (1977) 83|''Star Wars'' (1977) 83]] {{1st}}</ref>
